title: Fix OpenAI-compat streaming tool_call deltas to avoid stalled streams
author: ethan_park
description:
Problem
- SUP-3015: enterprise escalation where stream=true + tools causes the stream to emit one chunk then stall forever (no [DONE]).

Root cause
- Our OpenAI-compat adapter mapped provider tool-call deltas into an internal event that never transitioned the stream state machine to "final". In some cases we also failed to flush after a tool_call delta.

Fix
- Normalize tool_calls delta shape to match the OpenAI streaming contract (always emit delta + finish_reason when complete).
- Always emit a terminal [DONE] event even if the provider ends on a tool_call boundary.
- Add regression tests: streaming tool_calls, mixed content+tool deltas, and multiple tool calls.

Notes
- No API surface change; this is correctness + streaming reliability.

Review
- maya_srinivasan: please ensure this doesn't break non-streaming tool call formatting
- ethan_park: added snapshot tests for non-streaming response shape

Merge
- Squash merged to main; will be deployed to eu-west first then global.
